factory: init: create prerun stage for inhibiting/overriding jobs Refered CL:1675408. This CL move job inhitbiting logic from factory_utils.sh to factory repo. We create an stage called prerun which will be executed at chromeos_startup stage (upstart "startup" job). cryptohome: Return retry action from chall-resp Decrypt Enhance the challenge-response credentials decryption implementation (the ChallengeCredentialsDecryptOperation class) to additionally return whether the operation failure could have been transient (using the TpmRetryAction enum). This CL is a pure refactoring CL. It allows to implement the "retry on transient TPM error" functionality in a follow-up. BUG=chromium:842791,chromium:985509 TEST=existing tests Change-Id: Ie95a59149eeb95200526bdcc76880da0fbfe930a Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1710571 Tested-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org>

cryptohome: Retry chall-resp decrypt errors Add retry logic into the decryption operations of challenge-response mounts (a.k.a. smart card login). This allows to overcome transient TPM errors, for example the errors caused by hitting the maximum number of simultaneously allowed TPM 2.0 sessions (which is currently 3) due to some parallel background activity in the OS. In particular, such problematic scenarios occur quite often during automated testing: during handling the CheckKeyEx request that is made shortly after a MountEx request, in which case our CheckKeyEx handler is fighting with the PKCS11 token initialization logic in the chaps daemon. BUG=chromium:842791,chromium:985509 TEST=(a) tast run $IP hwsec.ChallengeResponseMount; (b) issue CheckKeyEx command for a challenge-response mount quickly after the MountEx command Change-Id: Ic9797caa76713aa9d9d8b02591d0f65f47f10dd5 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1709317 Tested-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org>

cryptohome: Skip useless migrations of chall-resp keysets Avoid trying to migrate the challenge-response keys when it's unnecessary (currently - always). The old code was seeing two facts - the TPM is available and that the keyset is not encrypted via the TPM - and therefore was trying to perform the migration (re-encryption) of the keyset. This was anyway producing the same keyset, so this all was just a waste of resources.
